Supabase JS 2.117.3

This is the same UMD bundle resolved by the application's existing
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2 dependency on 2026-10-09.
It is served locally and included in the PWA cache so opening the interface
does not wait for a separate CDN request. Account and synchronization APIs
are unchanged.
